AI for CAD and engineering workflows

AI-assisted CAD work starts with a clear engineering request, selected context and a result you can inspect. Explore how to frame that request for your tools, then check which Vector OS connectors are available for your build.

From a request to a reviewable result.

  1. Choose the context. Name the application, document and objects or graph you mean. State the desired result and the relationships that must stay.
  2. Plan before a change. Ask for an explanation or review the proposed steps. A planning example does not demonstrate that a native operation is supported.
  3. Verify in the host. For a supported native task, review the exact approval and inspect the application result. A model reply is different from a verified engineering outcome.

Ask, Plan and Build are task modes. Design and Project are workspace layouts. Compare the workspace views or read the task-mode guide.

The website preview is interactive and scripted; it runs no live AI or CAD commands. Windows beta access is by request. Supported hosts, modules and features depend on the supplied build. Check current connector status and see recorded examples.
